record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: spawn-time marker passive (PassiveEffects entry with one OnSpawnEffect) that other code also tests by name
record.summary: On spawn each INANIMATE entity gets status.tree = true, 30000 ms of rune protection (triggerRuneProtect clears negative statuses and blocks new ones) and is put in the idle state. Separately, many places test passive === INANIMATE: toMovingState and toAttackingState return immediately (it never moves or attacks), idle-state makes an INANIMATE entity that has a PP bar (maxPP > 0, i.e. BUG_NEST with SWARM) cast its skill with no target when pp >= maxPP, status code refuses resurrection and Pokerus, and several getters/loops exclude it (cannot be cloned or copied or eat, does not count for team size or as a played Pokemon, ignored for bot team building, the Drummer check and the damage count of an enemy team). The three pillars have maxPP 0, atk 0, speed 0 and Ability.DEFAULT, so they only stand on the board as targets. No numeric stat is changed by the passive.
triggers: OnSpawnEffect when the entity is created in a simulation (fight start or spawn)
Per-tick idle-state update for the PP-bar cast
Direct passive === INANIMATE checks in the listed callers

effects.scaling: none (no AP, no crit); the 30000 is a literal in the effect, not reduced by status-duration helpers in the lines read
effects.resolution: triggerRuneProtect sets the flag, clears negative statuses and stores the larger timer; updateRuneProtect counts it down; the combat effect of tree is in canMove/canAttack/addPP/silence

effects.declaredRaw: never enters moving or attacking state
effects.resolution: toMovingState / toAttackingState return early for passive INANIMATE (and for tree)

effects.declaredRaw: INANIMATE entity with maxPP > 0 casts its skill (no target) when pp >= maxPP; tree is cleared first by the earlier branch
effects.scaling: depends on the skill (SWARM for BUG_NEST; not covered here)

effects.declaredRaw: no resurrection, no Pokerus, cannot be copied, cloned or eat, not counted for team size / played Pokemon / enemy damage count / drum / bot team
effects.resolution: early returns and filters at each caller

conditions: The three pillars and the nest are the only catalog units with this passive; units sharing the identifier but not listed are not covered.

Whether tree is ever cleared for the pillars: their maxPP is 0, so the idle-state branch that clears tree needs maxPP > 0 and does not apply; BUG_NEST (maxPP 80) clears tree when pp >= maxPP and then casts on later idle updates.
Rune protection lasts 30000 ms from spawn (a literal); after that negative statuses are no longer blocked by it, but tree (where still set) keeps blocking silence.
record.resetBehaviour: Entity status is built per fight; nothing persists. Tree is cleared only by the idle-state branch (maxPP > 0, pp >= maxPP) or by TRANSE (transe.ts) for other units.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: How PP is gained by a BUG_NEST that never attacks or takes part in the fight (PP-per-second or on-hit sources) - not traced here
Targeting: whether enemies target INANIMATE units like any other unit is not part of this record (the moving-state check covers only the Drummer)
unresolved: ALSO_REFERENCED_ELSEWHERE: the passive is tested by name in the listed files; a name grep over app/ (excluding public/ and precomputed data) was used, other code reading it indirectly (e.g. via canBeCopied callers, tree, or the unit class flags canHoldItems/canBeSold/canBeBenched) was not enumerated
Callers of canBeCopied, canBeCloned, canEat and doesCountForTeamSize were not traced
Pillar and nest placement (Player.updatePillars, the board spawn rules) were not read
Whether the PP bar of BUG_NEST fills in practice and what the first idle-state branch then does to the animation state was not examined
The effect of status.tree on targeting/damage by enemies was not examined
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
